# Unit test for function circular_shift
def test_circular_shift():
    # Normal circular shift: shift less than length
    assert circular_shift(12, 1) == "21"          # last 1 digit moved to front
    assert circular_shift(1234, 2) == "3412"      # last 2 digits moved to front
    assert circular_shift(12345, 3) == "34512"

    # Shift equal to length: returns original string
    assert circular_shift(123, 3) == "123"
    assert circular_shift(0, 1) == "0"

    # Shift greater than length: returns reversed string
    assert circular_shift(12, 100) == "21"
    assert circular_shift(123, 4) == "321"
    assert circular_shift(0, 2) == "0"            # reversed single digit

    # Shift of zero: no shift, returns original
    assert circular_shift(12345, 0) == "12345"

    # Single-digit numbers
    assert circular_shift(7, 1) == "7"

    # Negative number: sign character participates in shift
    assert circular_shift(-12, 1) == "2-1"
    assert circular_shift(-123, 2) == "23-1"

    print("All tests passed!")
